topic: 非谓语动词核心破译与考纲进阶（To do / Doing / Done）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就像是动词变身成了“变形金刚”。一句话里通常只能有一个核心“保镖”（谓语动词）。如果还想加入其他动作，这些动词就必须变身为名词、形容词或副词，去干别的活儿（做主语、宾语、定语或状语）！
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
- To do（动词不定式）：表“将来、未发生、具体目的”；
- Doing（动名词/现在分词）：表“习惯、正在进行、主动”；
- Done（过去分词）：表“被动、已经完成”。
- 记忆口诀：“一句不容二谓语，非谓变身来补位；To表将来与目的，Doing正在与主动，Done表被动已完成！”
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
- 易错1：双谓语冲突。如 *I like play games*（❌） -> 应改为 *I like playing games*（✔️）。
- 易错2：分词混淆（-ing修饰物/表令人...，-ed修饰人/表感到...）。如 *I am boring*（❌，意为我是个无趣的人） -> 应改为 *I am bored*（✔️，感到无聊）。
- 易错3：介词to与不定式符号to混淆。如 *look forward to do*（❌） -> 应改为 *look forward to doing*（✔️）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- She decided to study hard for the exam.（她决定为考试努力学习。- 不定式表目的/未发生）
- Learning English is fun and useful.（学习英语既有趣又有用。- 动名词作主语）
- Encouraged by the teacher, he made rapid progress.（受到老师的鼓励，他进步迅速。- 过去分词表被动状语）

questions.question: Tom wants ________ a new bicycle for his 10th birthday.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 want to do sth.（想要做某事），不定式 to buy 作宾语，表示未发生的动作。

questions.question: My sister enjoys ________ storybooks in the school library after class.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 enjoy doing sth.（喜欢做某事），后接动名词 reading 作宾语。

questions.question: We need to stop ________ now because our English teacher is coming in.
questions.explanation: 考查 stop doing 与 stop to do 的区别。根据后半句“老师进来了”，可知是“停止正在做的事（说话）”，用 stop talking。

questions.question: Don't forget ________ your homework before going to bed tonight.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“忘记要做某事（未做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某事（已做）”。此处提醒睡觉前去交作业，应用不定式 to turn in。

questions.question: The box is too heavy for the little girl ________ .
questions.explanation: 考查经典句型 too... to...（太……以至于不能……），不定式 to carry 在句中作结果状语。

questions.question: Thank you for ________ me with my English homework yesterday.
questions.explanation: for 为介词，介词后面接动词时要用动名词形式（doing），故选 helping。

questions.question: My mother finished ________ the dishes ten minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 finish doing sth.（完成做某事），后接动名词 washing。

questions.question: They decided ________ a picnic in the park this weekend.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 decide to do sth.（决定做某事），动词不定式表将来的动作。

questions.question: Lucy is very interested in ________ beautiful flowers in her garden.
questions.explanation: 考查短语 be interested in doing sth.（对做某事感兴趣），in 是介词，后接动名词 planting。

questions.question: The boy practices ________ the piano for one hour every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 practice doing sth.（练习做某事），后接动名词 playing。

questions.question: I remember ________ the key on the desk, but now it is missing!
questions.explanation: remember doing sth. 表示“记得做过某事（已发生）”；remember to do 表示“记得要做某事（未发生）”。语境为“记得把钥匙放桌上了”，故选 putting。

questions.question: We plan ________ Paris during the coming summer holiday.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 plan to do sth.（计划做某事），后接不定式 to visit。

questions.question: Our English teacher keeps ________ us to read more books.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 keep doing sth.（坚持/不断做某事），后接动名词 telling。

questions.question: Sam hopes ________ a great scientist like Albert Einstein in the future.
questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 hope to do sth.（希望做某事），注意 hope 不能直接接 hope sb to do，此处接不定式 to become 作宾语。

questions.question: My brother spent two hours ________ his broken bicycle yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型 spend time (in) doing sth.（花费时间做某事），介词 in 可省略，动词用 fixing。

questions.question: The sudden loud noise made the sleeping baby ________ violently.
questions.explanation: 考查使役动词 make 的用法：make sb. do sth.（让某人做某事），接不带 to 的不定式作宾语补足语。

questions.question: As I walked past the playground, I saw a group of students ________ basketball enthusiastically.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词 see 的用法。see sb. doing sth. 表示“看到某人正在做某事（强调动作正在进行）”；see sb. do sth. 强调全过程。此处表示走过时看到正在打球，故选 playing。

questions.question: The young girl ________ next to the window is the top student in our grade.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词作后置定语。girl 与 sit 之间是主动关系且表示状态，故用现在分词 sitting 修饰 the young girl。

questions.question: The smartphone ________ by my uncle last week works exceptionally well.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作后置定语。smartphone 与 repair 之间是被动关系且动作已完成，故用过去分词 repaired。

questions.question: ________ the tragic news on TV, the heartbroken woman burst into tears.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词作时间/原因状语。主语 the woman 与 hear 之间是主动关系，用现在分词 Hearing 相当于 When she heard...

questions.question: ________ by his teacher's inspiring words, the student redoubled his efforts.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词作状语。逻辑主语 the student 与 encourage 之间是被动关系（受到鼓励），故用过去分词 Encouraged。

questions.question: The health expert suggested ________ at least eight glasses of water every day.
questions.explanation: 考查 suggest 的用法。suggest 后可直接接动名词 doing 作宾语（suggest doing sth.），不能直接接 suggest sb to do。

questions.question: All the students are looking forward to ________ the famous scientist at the summit.
questions.explanation: 考查高频易错点：look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 meeting，而非动词原形。

questions.question: To avoid ________ careless mistakes in the exam, you should check your answers carefully.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词作宾语。avoid 只能接动名词做宾语（avoid doing sth. 避免做某事）。

questions.question: The team had great difficulty ________ a practical solution to the crisis.
questions.explanation: 考查句型 have difficulty (in) doing sth.（做某事有困难），in 被省略，动词需用动名词形式 finding。

questions.question: ________ all his tasks ahead of schedule, the manager left the office with satisfaction.
questions.explanation: 考查完成时分词（Having done）。主语 the manager 与 finish 是主动关系，且“完成任务”明显发生在“离开办公室”之前，故用 Having finished。

questions.question: This urgent issue needs ________ thoroughly before any final decision is made.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的被动语态。主语 issue 与 discuss 是被动关系，need to be done 表示“需要被做”；（注：若用动名词则为 needs discussing）。

questions.question: With all the preparations ________ , the concert started right on time.
questions.explanation: 考查 With 复合结构（With + 宾语 + 宾补）。preparations 与 complete 是被动且已完成关系，用过去分词 completed 作宾补。

questions.question: The suspect was observed ________ out of the building carrying a heavy briefcase.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词/使役动词在被动语态中的还原现象。主动语态为 see/observe sb. do sth.（省略 to），变被动语态时必须还原 to，即 be observed to do sth.。

questions.question: ________ several times about the hidden risks, he still decided to invest in the project.
questions.explanation: 考查分词的完成被动式（Having been done）。主语 he 与 warn 是被动关系（被警告），且警告发生在决定投资之前，故用 Having been warned 作状语。
